scope: Original-clock and cross-history feature coverage diagnosis; no fitting, relabeling, deployment or evaluation-role access
neighbor_policy: One nearest valid TRAIN scene; exclude entire same original recording for TRAIN queries; all TRAIN for development. Squared Euclidean distance divided by576. No query labels in selection.
lag_policy: Descriptive physical response only. Positive lag compares original target at t to measured body yaw at t+lag; future body is never an actor input. No best-lag selection or original target modification.
